technical_and_design_decisions: U1: Use existing Spring AMQP dead letter queue mechanism and add a new configuration property to specify an alternative DLQ. Include the exception and stack trace as additional message headers.

U2: Use Debezium as the change data capture (CDC) engine to consume database changes, exposing them as a Spring Cloud Stream source module. Support output to multiple destinations (Brokers, Hadoop, DB) via configurable bindings.
U3: Enhance Spring AMQP's ConnectionFactory to support a list of broker addresses for RabbitMQ clusters. Implement automatic failover logic to switch to a healthy node upon connection loss.

U4: Upgrade Spring Data Gemfire to the version aligned with Gemfire 8.1 and the Spring Data Gosling GA release. Update Maven/Gradle dependencies and perform compatibility testing on existing BDS stack.

U5: For colocated deployment, modify the stream deployment mechanism to allow all modules of a stream to run in the same container (same JVM). For leader election, integrate with Spring Cloud Cluster (ZooKeeeper/Consul) to enable automatic failover of the entire stream between containers.
U6: Upgrade Spring Integration to the specified milestone/GA release to incorporate JMX improvements. Update the dependency declaration in the project's POM and run integration tests.
U7: Upgrade Spring Integration Kafka to the latest available release to synchronize with latest improvements and bug fixes. Update dependency and verify Kafka connector functionality.

U8: Upgrade Spring Boot to version 1.2.3 and update all listed dependency versions (logback, jackson, gemfire, h2, etc.) in the project's dependency management section. Ensure compatibility across modules and run the full test suite.
